userStories.notes: pkg/pipeline/cdc: connector-agnostic CDC framework on top of jackc/pglogrepl. Layered as types (TableMapping, Config, ChangeEvent) → mapper (EventToEdit emits funnel.Edit with EditSourceIngest so user-edit-wins still beats CDC) → stateful Decoder (caches Relation messages, stamps txn LSN/CommitTime onto each Insert/Update/Delete, signals commit boundary so the receiver can flush) → Receiver (per-ontology batch grouping, CommitWatermark on flush so PG advances confirmed_flush_lsn idempotently) → PGSource (real pglogrepl-backed transport, IDENTIFY_SYSTEM + START_REPLICATION on the supplied replication conn, in-line keepalive replies, standby-status acks). Composite primary keys join via oms.CompositeKeySeparator (':'). REPLICA IDENTITY DEFAULT keys-only update tuples are honoured (non-key columns absent rather than NULL). TOASTed unchanged columns silently skip so existing indexed values stay put. NULL is encoded with a private sentinel inside the flat string tuple maps; mapper.IncludeNullProperties=true forwards them to the Edit so MODIFY can clear fields. Multi-ontology transactions split into one EditBatch per ontology on commit. cmd/server/cdc_receiver.go opt-in wiring: WEAVE_CDC_DSN (must include replication=database explicitly), WEAVE_CDC_SLOT (default weave_cdc), WEAVE_CDC_PUBLICATION (default weave_cdc_pub), WEAVE_CDC_MAPPINGS / _FILE; degraded-mode silent skip when DSN absent. Tests: 35 unit tests covering Config validation, mapper happy/error paths, Decoder Insert/Update/Delete/TOAST/keys-only/unknown-relation/zero-LSN-pre-Begin paths via constructed pglogrepl typed messages, Receiver per-txn flush + multi-ontology split + unmapped-table drop + ctx-cancel + publish-failure-aborts + Run drains scripted Source through io.EOF.
